units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 2:4">Shebi. II, 4</cite> <he>וקוֹטְמִין אותן</he> and trim them; [oth. opin., v. <cite ref="S00787"><he>קָטַם</he> II</cite>].

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:41">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>הקוֹטְמָהּ</he> he that clips it (the wing-feather); <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 9:20">Tosef. ib. IX</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 10:20">X</cite>), 20; Bab.

<cite ref="Beitzah 33b:2">Bets. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>לא יִקְטְמֶנּוּ … ואם קְטָמוֹ וכ׳</he> one must not nip it in order to smell at it, but if one did &c.; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>קָטוּם</he>; f. <cite ref="S00727"><he>קְטוּמָה</he></cite>; pl. <he>קְטוּמִים</he> &c.

Succ. III, 4 שנים ק׳ ואחד אינו ק׳ if two (of the three myrtle sprigs) are broken on the top, and one is not. Y. ib. 53ᶜ bot. ק׳ הדר even if the point is broken off, it may still be called hadar (beautiful); ib.ᵈ top ק׳ הדור; a. e.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 2:1">Tosef. B. Kam. II, 1</cite>, v. <cite ref="S02009"><he>קִרְטֵם</he></cite>
<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 3:1">Succ. III, 1</cite> <he>נ׳ ראשו</he> if its top is broken off; <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 3:2">ib. 2</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 3:3">3</cite>; a. e.
